title: Truncate text on a word boundary with an ellipsis
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: Scanning spaces from the end returns the longest trimmed prefix of at most limit - 3 characters, falls back to the hard cut, and throws the required errors.
It describes truncate in prose and contains no JavaScript code, so there is no function to run.
It only looks for a space inside the first limit - 3 characters, so truncate("The quick brown fox", 12) returns "The..." instead of "The quick..." when the prefix uses all limit - 3 characters.
A single forward pass records the trimmed prefix length at every space that still fits, which yields the largest valid cut, and the hard cut applies only to an over-long first word.
